scientific_integrity: Exact all-n proof via forbidden-column characterization, inclusion-exclusion and prime-factorization; deterministic independent exhaustive integer checks through n=7, graph-cycle check through n=5. Claims of absolute historical priority or independent certification are not made.
scientific_limitations: The exact statement concerns labelled K_{2,n}, n>=2, and unnormalized Walsh counting convolution on its binary edge-orientation cube. It does not address higher first-shore sizes, non-Hilbert inverse condition numbers, or external independent validation. A possibly earlier entrywise weighted lonesum identity is an explicit priority risk.
title: Reversal-rigid Walsh spectrum of acyclic orientations of \(K_{2,n}\)
